item.title: Chicago Bulls lose 11th straight loss to make history — but it was their biggest win since the trade deadline
item.description: For the first time in franchise history, the Chicago Bulls went the entire month of February without winning a game. This type of milestone is both damning and baffling.

item.title: Asking Eric: How do I get my old friend to take a chill pill?
item.description: Dear Eric: I have a friend, proud of his Jewish heritage, who I have known since we were kids. He spends as much time in the synagogue as I spend in the church (i.e., not much), but he is always holding up his religion as his badge of honor.

item.title: Chicago Blackhawks let late lead slip away in 4-2 loss to Nashville Predators in rusty return from break
item.description: The Chicago Blackhawks returned from the three-week Olympic break Thursday night, falling to the Nashville Predators 4-2 for their seventh loss in eight games.
